name: Lucy Blue
bio:
Lucy Blue is a highly skilled tattoo artist known for her impressive styles in illustrative and neotraditional tattoos. Her proficiency is evident in her substantial following of about 76,000 on Instagram. Her portfolio, which is shared primarily on this platform, showcases her fantastic and meticulous craftsmanship, making her a sought-after inker in Leeds, UK. Describing herself as both a tattooist and an illustrator, Lucy further highlights her expertise in creating profoundly artistic and distinctive pieces.
